maintenance_only.description: Evidence-led candidate clusters for observable desire events: blocked approach to an inaccessible target, immediate-reward versus long-term-goal conflict, repeated acquisition without use, accumulation beyond capacity, an overt claim toward another adult's owned object, unfair extra-share taking, a public recognition bid with audience response, pursuit of a next milestone, and acquisition of resource-control authority. Broad desire, longing, greed, ambition, power, envy, obsession, philosophical, religious, and clinical labels remain advisory by themselves.
